rows.sentence: As a second check, this page looks at the DIGITS in your note. It leaves the note out when it finds a Social Security number, a card number, a bank, licence or passport number, or a date of birth written in many ways, including spelled out in words, split with commas, or hidden in base64 or hex. Only the tick box and you stop those.
